# #3917: CI: a patches promotion or log is stuck
Opened by @github-actions[bot].

<!-- stuck #3916 -->
The card-patch promotion https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/pull/3916 (`patches ship`, R646) has been open over 2 hours and did not merge itself:

- [rust (test cards lib)](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/43571485008/job/132377254643)
- [rust](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/43571485008/job/132378629804)

Until it merges, the patches it ships are not live as versions: `CATALOG_VERSION` stays where it was and the patch notes do not show them.

Fix it on a branch from main: a check that only fails here usually reads the shipped history (`crates/cards/patches/`) and must hold for the history this promotion ships, so check out its branch and run the failing tests there to see it fail first, then show them pass there with the fix. A conflict alone needs no fix. Close this issue with the fix's pull request (or, for a conflict alone, by hand); the watch in `.github/workflows/patches-ship.yml` then ships again from the newer main, and that promotion supersedes this one.

If they are red for a reason outside the repository (CI out of minutes, a spending limit, billing, an account, a runner that never started), no change here fixes it: open the plan with a `**Human required:**` line saying what a person must do, and build nothing.

<!-- jackioh-bot:plan -->
## Plan

_Written by `claude-8` (claude, `opus`, strong) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/43581778259)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

**Goal.** Promotion #3916 (`patches ship`: v0.6.2c, #3903's phone/full-art fix, then v0.6.3, Stinkyscape Balance Changes V) is red only in `rust (test cards lib)` (`cargo test -p jackioh-cards --lib`) and in `rust`, the job that collects every rust result. I reproduced it on this worktree's base (9889adcf9b). In a scratch worktree I ran `cargo jackioh patches ship` and then CI's command for the group. 9,812 tests pass and one fails: `history::tests::r3538002_past_ids_are_play_alike_runs_before_the_reference` (`crates/cards/src/history.rs:1404`), with `["core-013@v0.3.1", "core-013@v0.5.11s", "core-013@v0.6.2c"]`, left 3, right 2.

The cause: the test counts Core #13 Jlockeed Shredder-10's past versions at `crate::CATALOG_VERSION`, which every promotion moves. Balance V changes Core #13 (5/7), so at the new version there is a third past version. Done means the test reads a fixed shipped version and passes on both main's history and the history this promotion ships. Then the issue closes with the fix's pull request, and the watch ships again from the newer main.

**Files to touch.**

| Path | new/change | What |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/cards/src/history.rs` | change | In `mod tests`, only `fn r3538002_past_ids_are_play_alike_runs_before_the_reference`: its reference becomes the shipped version `"v0.6.2b"` instead of `crate::CATALOG_VERSION`, and it compares against that version's definition |

Do not touch: `crates/cards/patches/**` (no fragment, no snapshot, no `patches.json` or `technical.json` edit; the fix is internal, a test only), `KEPT_SCRIPTS` or any other code in `history.rs`, the engine, the tools, `apps/web`, `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`. The rulings that govern it are R3538002 (past ids are play-alike runs before a reference version) and R767000 (carried versions). No new ruling, since no rules decision is made.

**Steps.**

1. In `crates/cards/src/history.rs`, `mod tests`, `fn r3538002_past_ids_are_play_alike_runs_before_the_reference` (about line 1401), replace everything from the first comment line through the end of the `for id in &ids { … }` loop, and the comment line after it, with exactly this (already rustfmt'd):

```rust
        // Core #13 Jlockeed Shredder-10 played three ways from v0.3.0c through v0.6.2b: two past
        // versions before v0.6.2b. The reference is a shipped version, not the build's own, so the
        // count holds on every history a promotion appends (#3917: Stinkyscape Balance Changes V
        // changed the card again, a third past version before the build's).
        let reference = "v0.6.2b";
        let ids = past_ids("core-013", reference);
        assert_eq!(ids.len(), 2, "{ids:?}");
        assert!(
            ids.windows(2).all(|pair| pair[0] < pair[1]),
            "oldest first: {ids:?}"
        );
        let reference_def = catalog_defs_at(reference)
            .and_then(|defs| defs.get("core-013"))
            .expect("v0.6.2b carries Core #13");
        for id in &ids {
            let past = past_def(id).expect("a past definition");
            assert!(past.id == *id, "its id is the past id");
            assert!(
                !plays_alike(past, reference_def),
                "{id} plays differently from {reference}'s"
            );
        }
        // At an older version only the runs before it show, a subset of the reference's.
```

   This removes `let now = crate::card_def("core-013");`. Keep the three `then` lines that follow unchanged (`let then = past_ids("core-013", "v0.4.0");` and its two asserts).

2. In the same function, change `assert!(past_ids("stinkyscapeplus-033", crate::CATALOG_VERSION).is_empty());` to `assert!(past_ids("stinkyscapeplus-033", reference).is_empty());`. Leave the last two asserts (`v0.0.0-unknown`) as they are.

3. Change nothing else. `catalog_defs_at` and `plays_alike` are already in scope through `use super::*`.

**Tests.**

- The changed test is `crates/cards/src/history.rs`, `history::tests::r3538002_past_ids_are_play_alike_runs_before_the_reference`. It asserts that Core #13 has exactly 2 past ids before v0.6.2b, oldest first, each unlike v0.6.2b's definition. It also asserts that v0.4.0's past ids are a 1-element subset, and that the held card `stinkyscapeplus-033` has no past at v0.6.2b.
- Run it on main's history: `cargo test -p jackioh-cards --lib history::` (all 15 history and patch_history tests pass).
- Run it on the promotion's history, which is what the issue asks for: `sh scripts/worktree.sh ship-3917`, copy the edited `crates/cards/src/history.rs` into `../jackioh-wt/ship-3917/`, and in that worktree run `cargo jackioh patches ship`. Expect `shipped v0.6.2c` and `shipped v0.6.3`. Then run `cargo test -p jackioh-cards --lib --config profile.test.package.jackioh-engine.opt-level=1 --config profile.test.package.jackioh-cards.opt-level=0` there. Expect 0 failures. With the original test, the same tree fails at `history.rs:1404` with left 3, right 2. Remove that worktree afterwards (`git worktree remove --force ../jackioh-wt/ship-3917`); do not commit in it.
- The planner already ran the steps above with this exact code: the fixed test passes on both histories, `cargo fmt --check -p jackioh-cards` is clean, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-cards --all-targets -- -D warnings` is clean, and `cargo jackioh classify --base HEAD --claims` prints `classify: Internal`.

**Done when.**

- [ ] Only the one test in `crates/cards/src/history.rs` changed (steps 1 and 2).
- [ ] The test passes on main's history and on the history `patches ship` writes (v0.6.2c and v0.6.3), and the whole `jackioh-cards --lib` suite passes on the shipped tree.
- [ ] rustfmt, catalog, patches, rulings (`spec check`), clippy and cargo tests are green; `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` passes (Internal, no fragment).
- [ ] The scratch worktree is removed. The report says the PR closes #3917, and that the watch then supersedes #3916 with a promotion from the newer main.

**Risks.**

- Determinism, replays and hidden information are untouched: this is a test-only change, and no script, `KEPT_SCRIPTS` row or history data moves.
- The pinned version must stay a frozen fact. v0.6.2b is shipped and its snapshot never changes, so the count stays 2 whatever later patches do to Core #13. It would change only if `BROWSER_CARRIED_FROM` (`crates/cards/build.rs`, `"v0.3.0c"`) moves past v0.3.1, and that is already true of the test today.
- On main, v0.6.2b is `CATALOG_VERSION`, so `past_ids` uses the catalog as "now". After the ship it uses v0.6.2b's run. Both give the same two ids, verified on both trees.
- Don't run `cargo jackioh patches ship` in the delivered worktree; it rewrites the history. Use the scratch worktree only.

**Open questions.**

- **For a person, not this fix (a separate issue):** `KEPT_SCRIPTS` (`crates/cards/src/history.rs`) names a version older than the newest one that ran the old script, because a promotion shipped while the patch's branch was open.
  - Jungle Loser's row (#3802) is kept at `"v0.6.0g"`, but the v0.6.1 and v0.6.1b snapshots still hold its `chance` param. So v0.6.1/v0.6.1b replays meeting it fold under the new script, and the test `r767000_jungle_loser_roll_is_kept_through_the_newest_version_that_ran_it` stops at v0.6.0g.
  - The six #3837 rows are kept at `"v0.6.1b"`, but v0.6.2, v0.6.2b and, after this promotion, v0.6.2c hold the pre-Balance-V definitions. Their replays and R3538002 past ids (for example `core-052@v0.6.2c`) would run the new scripts.
  - Which version each row should name is ambiguous. v0.6.1b games were played both with and without the roll: main ran the new script at v0.6.1b from #3810's merge until v0.6.2 shipped. Bumping the rows changes how existing replays fold, and v0.6.2c doesn't exist on main until #3916's successor merges. A guard (for example in `patches check` or `patches ship`) would be a cross-crate design call, so I left it out of this fix.
